message:
The other day, we were packing our go-bags as a family. I was trying to explain the importance of having essentials ready, and of course, my kids were more interested in which snacks to include. I chuckled when one of them suggested packing their favorite toy instead of a flashlight! 

It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t have to be all serious. We can make it fun, too! Balancing the practical with a little playfulness not only keeps the kids engaged but also helps them understand why we do this together. 

So, how do you mix fun into your family preparedness plans? 🌟
